en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall cylindrical monument with a colonnaded base, crenellated top, and a statue holding a wreath above. A winged railway wheel decorates the side. Trees and a fence surround the monument. The caption at the bottom reads "TECUCI – Monumentul ceferiștilor." The back bears standard postcard divisions and Romanian text indicating the Romanian People's Republic.
